definitions.explanation: The western-central region of Japan's main island, including Osaka, Kyoto, Kobe, and surrounding prefectures.

examples.japanese: {関西|かんさい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方言|ほうげん}→方言：07419_hougen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: A distinctive dialect is spoken in the Kansai region.

examples.japanese: {関西|かんさい}⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。

notes:
{関西|かんさい} refers to the western-central region of Honshu, Japan's main island.

Key areas included:
- ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦{府|ふ}→府：noentry⟧ (Osaka Prefecture)
- ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦{府|ふ}→府：noentry⟧ (Kyoto Prefecture)
- ⟦{兵庫|ひょうご}→兵庫：noentry⟧⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧ (Hyogo - includes Kobe)
- ⟦{奈良|なら}→奈良：noentry⟧⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧ (Nara Prefecture)
- ⟦{滋賀|しが}→滋賀：noentry⟧⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧ (Shiga Prefecture)
- ⟦{和歌山|わかやま}→和歌山：noentry⟧⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧ (Wakayama Prefecture)

Cultural notes:
- Known for {関西|かんさい}⟦{弁|べん}→弁：noentry⟧ (Kansai dialect)
- Cultural center before Tokyo rose to prominence
- Famous for comedy (⟦{漫才|まんざい}→漫才：04458_manzai⟧, ⟦{吉本|よしもと}→吉本：noentry⟧)

Opposite region:
- ⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧ (Kanto - Tokyo area)
